title: imap: advertise IMAP4REV2 and NAMESPACE in capability_list
description:
Add IMAP4REV2 and NAMESPACE to the capability list returned by capability_list() in crates/imap/src/session/commands.rs.

Algorithm:
1. Add Capability::try_from("IMAP4rev2").expect("valid atom") to the caps vec. This routes to Capability::Other(CapabilityOther(...)) and renders as IMAP4rev2 on the wire. It is unconditional (pre- and post-auth, TLS and non-TLS).
2. Add Capability::Namespace to the caps vec (available after ext_namespace feature is enabled). Also unconditional.
3. Do NOT add STATUS=SIZE — it is deferred pending upstream library support.
4. Update the capability_data() unit tests (lines 54–133) to assert IMAP4rev2 and NAMESPACE appear in the output.

Defensive rules: the try_from must use .expect() with a message explaining the atom is a compile-time constant and cannot fail. No unwrap() without comment.

Acceptance: cargo test -p stoa-imap passes; capability_list unit tests assert IMAP4REV2 present; capability_list unit tests assert NAMESPACE present.
